title: Allocator-war public-route execution Wave 31
purpose: Execute all thirty-four publicly executable Wave 30 missing-row obligations through six amortized official source-system lanes while preserving four protected-personnel obligations as a separate lawful-access queue and refusing to convert base universes, published actions, formal review routes, or missing joins into complete denominators or findings.

route_plans.coverage_statement: Wave 31 preserves the four protected-personnel obligations without attempting public execution. Lawful aggregate, privacy-safe extract, or authorized person-level access remains required.
remaining_limits: privacy-safe or authorized personnel decision records
person-level comparator and no-action rows where lawful
decision custody and final outcomes subject to personnel protections
refused_substitutions: public workforce aggregates are not substituted for protected person-level decisions
public absence is not treated as secrecy, motive, uniformity, or no decisions
correction_route: authorized agency, grievance, MSPB, EEOC, union, court, FOIA, and Privacy Act channels

route_plans.coverage_statement: OPM workforce data, OPM public datasets, FWD documentation, and Federal Register APIs expose official aggregate workforce, published instrument, agency, date, and document surfaces. They do not expose complete agency inventory submissions, internal decision files, or a cross-agency no-action chronology.
recovered_surfaces: official workforce aggregate and change data
downloadable accession and separation datasets
published presidential, rule, notice, agency, and date metadata
publicly issued implementation instruments
remaining_limits: complete OMB and OPM agency inventory submissions
complete internal delegations, waivers, exceptions, overrides, recusals, dissent, and decision custody
complete cross-agency implementation and no-action chronology
refused_substitutions: aggregate workforce movement is not treated as a decision roster
published instruments are not treated as complete internal implementation files
named offices are not treated as personal motive or coordination
correction_route: OMB, OPM, DOJ, DOL, FAR Council, inspector-general, congressional, administrative, judicial, and FOIA routes

route_plans.coverage_statement: USAspending, SAM contract awards, SAM federal assistance, and Grants.gov expose machine-addressable award, contract, recipient, contractor, programme, agency, amount, status, and timing base universes. They do not identify the complete condition-specific certification, review, sanction, correction, and no-action universe.
recovered_surfaces: federal contract and grant base universes
recipient and contractor identifiers
agency, programme, award, amount, status, and timing fields
active and inactive contract actions and public assistance listings
remaining_limits: condition-specific covered-entity joins
all certifications, records requests, referrals, investigations, sanctions, appeals, settlements, declinations, and no-action rows
complete post-award recipient action and correction histories
refused_substitutions: the public base universe is not treated as the disputed action denominator
award receipt is not treated as violation, liability, coordination, or common purpose
opportunity records are not treated as post-award outcomes
correction_route: USAspending and SAM identifiers joined to agency award and action records
agency contract, grant, suspension and debarment, audit, appeal, and closeout files

route_plans.coverage_statement: The Federal Register, Civil Rights Fraud Initiative announcement, DOJ policy index, and the named IBM resolution expose published rule, policy, initiative, investigation, settlement, represented payment, and remediation surfaces. They do not constitute a complete enforcement, declination, referral, withdrawal, appeal, or no-action register.
recovered_surfaces: published rules, notices, and presidential documents
Civil Rights Fraud Initiative policy and reporting channel
one named 2026 False Claims Act resolution
represented payment and remediation terms
remaining_limits: complete referrals, investigations, certifications, records requests, settlements, declinations, withdrawals, appeals, and no-action rows
complete affected-sector, staffing, budget, timing, and recurrence denominator
realized payment and remediation performance
refused_substitutions: press releases are not substituted for complete case files or action registers
one resolution is not treated as prevalence or uniform enforcement
investigation or settlement is not treated as an admission unless the instrument states it
correction_route: DOJ, EEOC, agency civil-rights, Federal Register, case-file, settlement, inspector-general, congressional, administrative, and judicial records

route_plans.coverage_statement: GAO, PACER, and MSPB expose official protest, federal-court, and personnel-adjudication locator and decision surfaces. Public publication rules and access constraints demonstrate that these systems do not expose the complete denied, dismissed, abandoned, sealed, settled, implementation, cost, access, and durability denominator.
recovered_surfaces: GAO protest docket and published decisions
nationwide federal court case locator
MSPB case reports and decision indexes
formal filing, review, remand, dismissal, decision, and settlement routes
remaining_limits: complete administrative, grievance, protest, court, settlement, and correction universe
underlying pleadings, routine dismissals, sealed material, unsuccessful and abandoned paths
practical access, cost, timing, compliance, recurrence, reversal, and durability
refused_substitutions: formal review availability is not treated as effective correction
remand, dismissal, or settlement is not treated as final merits success
published decisions are not treated as the complete correction denominator
correction_route: MSPB, FSGB, EEOC, agency grievance, union, compliance, and appellate records

route_plans.coverage_statement: OPM, USAspending, SAM, and FAC expose separate workforce, award, contract, assistance, and audit universes. None supplies a complete, lawful join key that identifies all included, excluded, burdened, unaffected, corrected, comparator, recurrence, substitution, and no-effect rows for the contested institutional actions.
recovered_surfaces: separate workforce, award, contract, assistance, and audit base tables
agency, recipient, entity, programme, timing, and aggregate outcome dimensions
public data dictionaries and system boundaries
remaining_limits: lawful and complete affected-person or affected-entity join keys
unaffected and comparator populations
burden, no-effect, recurrence, substitution, reversal, durability, and distributional outcome rows
refused_substitutions: formal categories are not substituted for observed affected rows
named litigants or recipients are not treated as the full affected population
cross-system recurrence is not treated as prevalence, coordination, or common purpose
correction_route: agency programme, personnel, award, enforcement, audit, litigation, and comparator records with explicit entity-resolution rules

route_plans.coverage_statement: USAspending, SAM assistance, the named IBM resolution, and FAC data expose award amounts, programme and recipient surfaces, represented settlements, audit findings, and some corrective-action records. They do not form a complete substitution, continuity, clawback, repayment, realized recovery, loss, no-recovery, and performance ledger.
recovered_surfaces: federal award and assistance amounts
one represented Civil Rights Fraud Initiative settlement
single-audit award and finding records
public audit API and corrective-action fields
remaining_limits: complete programme substitution and continuity rows
recipient exit, replacement, clawback, repayment, realized recovery, loss, and no-recovery rows
public-private value allocation and performance after announced action
refused_substitutions: announced settlement value is not treated as realized recovery without execution records
programme termination is not treated as successful substitution
audit coverage is not treated as the complete recipient or award universe
correction_route: FAC audit, corrective-action, repayment, clawback, continuity, and performance records
